title: Card 4: link turant khulta (302), "click hua" ki khabar Kafka me. Ginti peeche, apni speed se

boxes.title: Kafka
lines: padhne ke baad bhi nahi mitata

callouts.red: Har click seedha DB me likh dete?
callouts.green: Har redirect DB me likhne ka intezaar karta, wahi dheemapan
Redirect phir bhi chalta. Bas kuch click ginti me nahi aate
Har click ki apni id hai. Wahi id dobara aayi to gino mat

callouts.red: Ek click ki khabar tooti hui aayi, padhi hi nahi ja rahi
callouts.green: Use alag line (DLQ) me daalo, baaki ginti chalti rahe
Khabar Kafka me padi rehti, wo apni speed se padh leta. Redirect pe asar nahi

callouts.red: Sirf Redis me ginti badha dete (INCR)?
callouts.green: Sirf ginti milti. Kaun, kab, kahan se click hua, wo nahi

callouts.red: 302 kyun, 301 kyun nahi? 301 pe browser link yaad rakh leta.
callouts.green: Agli baar click server tak aata hi nahi, to na ginti na expiry

callouts.red: Naya report chahiye? Kafka me pade purane click dobara padh lo (replay).
callouts.green: SQS kyun nahi? SQS padhte hi khabar mita deta, Kafka rakhta hai

kyun: Click khulte hi turant redirect (302), aur "click hua" ki khabar Kafka me daal do. Ginti wala apni speed se peeche padhta. Wo dheema ya band ho, Arpan ka link phir bhi turant khulta
peeche: card 3 me Counter se numbers ka dabba, number se chhota code
ab: Arpan ne click ginti chahi, redirect hi dheema ho gaya
agla: ab data hi itna ho gaya ki ek machine me nahi aata (card 5)
